master.title: 3rd International Conference on Solar Energy Photovoltaics, ICSPE 2019
master.content:
The proceedings contain 44 papers. The topics discussed include: effect of post annealing on the properties of aluminum doped zinc oxide thin films deposited by DC sputtering; nickel doped molybdenum oxide thin film counter electrodes as a low-cost replacement for platinum in dye sensitized solar cells; voltage and current profile improvement of a PV-integrated grid system employing sinusoidal current control strategy based unified power quality conditioner; structural and optical properties of in2s3 thin films deposited by sulfurization assisted thermal evaporation method; analysis of partial shading effect on energy output of different solar PV array configurations; reaction mechanism for pressureless sintering silicon carbide boron carbide composite; and photo assisted negative differential resistance in porous silicon: a potential nano-structure for hot carrier solar cell.

candidate.title: 2019 International Conference on Laser Deposition: Nanostructures, Hetero-structures and 2D layers, iCold 2019
candidate.content:
The proceedings contain 44 papers. The topics discussed include: effect of surface treatment on wetting behavior of copper; dairy wastewater treatment with bio-electricity generation using dual chambered membrane-less microbial fuel cell; pulsed laser deposition of SiC thin films and influence of laser-assisted annealing; electrical transport properties of polyaniline grafted radiation crosslinked chitosan; silver particulate films on softened polymer substrates pre-coated with selenium; a study on thermal conductivity enhancement of silicon carbide filler glass fiber epoxy resin hybrid composites; study on thermal resistance of brass with and without coating of metallic surface; and methanol crossover reduction and power enhancement of methanol fuel cells with polyvinyl alcohol coated nafion membranes.
